1.

The appellant-claimants who are pparents (appellants No. 1 and 2) and elder brother (appellant No. 3) have filed the present appeal seeking enhancement of the compensatio compensation of 63,16,252/- awarded to claimant No. 1 only/mother of deceased- deceased-Hardeep Singh by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, SBS Nagar (for shor short 'the learned Tribunal')) vide Award dated 18.10.2021, passed in MAC Petition No. 52 of 2019 dated 07.12.2019 filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, SBS Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Brief facts of the case are that the learned Tribunal on the basis of pleadings and evidence adduced before it concluded that deceased-Hardeep Hardeep Singh, Singh, had died in a motor vehicular accident that took place on 17.11.2019 due to the rash and negligent driving of Bus bearing registration No. PB-02-BU-9756 (hereinafter 'the offen offending vehicle') being driven drive by respondent No. 1-Amanjit Amanjit Singh; owned by respondents 1 of 3 FAO-2616 No. 2 to 4..

Learned Tribunal awarded the above compensation to claimant No. 1/mother along with interest @
7.5% % per annum from the date of filing the claim petition till actual realization.
All the respondents were held liable to pay the amount of compensation jointly and severally.

3. On the last date of hearing i.e. 16.10.2025,, following order was passed by this Court:-

sentences.text: It is inter alia submitted by learned counsel for the appellants that the deceased was a Sepoy in the Indian Ar Army my and was 23-  years old at the time of death.

It is submitted that while assessing the income/salary of the deceased certain deductions have been made by the Tribunal, which are not permitted as per the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in National Insurance ance Company Ltd. vs. Nalini and others 2024 SCC Online SC 2252 Law Finder Doc Id #2636955 and National Insurance Company Ltd. vs. Indira Srivastava and others 2008 (1) RCR (Civil) 359 Law Finder Doc Id #135913.

Heard.
Notice of motion for 03.3.2026.
Ms. Niharika iharika Sharma, AAG, Punjab accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos.2 to 4 and seeks time to file reply.
To be shown immediately after the urgent list.

4. It is reiterated by learned counsel for the appellant appellant-claimant claimant No. 1 that the deductions made by the learned Tribunal under the Heads Armed Forces Personal Provident Fund as well as the Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF), were not to be made in terms of judgment judgments of the Hon'ble Apex Court as mentioned mention in the order dated 16.10.2025,,
reproduced above.
2 of 3 FAO-2616 5. Learned counsel for the respondents is unable to dispute the above said decision in law.

6. Heard.
7.
